game_title: Patrol Decision Tree – Salt Pans Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Coastal Port – Salt Pans, salt evaporation pans: the harbor master must handle sea serpents while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Patrol Decision Tree: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions.
theme: Coastal Port – Salt Pans: salt evaporation pans
core_gameplay_loop: In Salt Pans, repeat each round: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the cover value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the dock crane using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The dock crane reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the dock crane is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 8 (extended tier): Patrol Decision Tree
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Patrol Decision Tree' (Week 3 slot 15), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Salt Pans'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how cover changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sea serpents in Salt Pans.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The dock crane reached with actions_used <= 14.
